text:
### Core Requirements  
1. **Identity Verification:** Mandatory at account opening
2. **Address Verification:** Mandatory at account opening
3. **Documentation:** Physical evidence required
4. **Record Retention:** 6 years post-account closure (see [[policy_retention]])
5. **Periodic Review:** Every 3–5 years for lower-risk customers; annually for high-risk customers
6. **Exception Process:** Escalation to Compliance Head for non-standard scenarios

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Identity Verification at Account Opening
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that identity verification must be performed at the point of account opening. This is a core Know Your Customer obligation applicable to all new accounts.
context: Identity Verification: Mandatory at account opening

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Address Verification at Account Opening
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that address verification must be performed at the point of account opening. This is a core Know Your Customer obligation applicable to all new accounts.
context: Address Verification: Mandatory at account opening

raw_entities.name: Physical Evidence Documentation Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that physical evidence must be obtained and retained as part of the identity and address verification process. This ensures documentary proof of customer identity and address.
context: Documentation: Physical evidence required

raw_entities.name: Record Retention for Six Years Post-Account Closure
raw_entities.description: A mandatory record retention requirement that all KYC documentation and account records must be retained for a period of six years following account closure. This ensures compliance with regulatory record-keeping obligations.
context: Record Retention: 6 years post-account closure

raw_entities.name: Periodic KYC Review for Lower-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: A mandatory periodic review requirement that lower-risk customers must have their KYC information reviewed every 3 to 5 years. This ensures ongoing compliance with Know Your Customer obligations for lower-risk customer segments.
context: Periodic Review: Every 3–5 years for lower-risk customers

raw_entities.name: Periodic KYC Review for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: A mandatory periodic review requirement that high-risk customers must have their KYC information reviewed annually. This ensures enhanced ongoing compliance monitoring for customers presenting elevated risk profiles.
context: annually for high-risk customers

raw_entities.name: Exception Process Escalation to Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that non-standard KYC scenarios must be escalated to the Compliance Head for approval and exception handling. This ensures senior oversight of cases that do not fit standard verification procedures.
context: Exception Process: Escalation to Compliance Head for non-standard scenarios

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: The Know Your Customer process of verifying a customer's identity at account opening. This is a mandatory control performed on all new accounts to establish the true identity of the account holder.
context: Identity Verification: Mandatory at account opening

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The Know Your Customer process of verifying a customer's address at account opening. This is a mandatory control performed on all new accounts to confirm the residential or business address of the account holder.
context: Address Verification: Mandatory at account opening

raw_entities.name: Periodic KYC Refresh
raw_entities.description: The ongoing Know Your Customer process of periodically reviewing and refreshing customer identity and address information. The frequency varies by risk profile: every 3–5 years for lower-risk customers and annually for high-risk customers.
context: Periodic Review: Every 3–5 years for lower-risk customers; annually for high-risk customers

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: A customer classification indicating elevated compliance risk requiring enhanced due diligence and more frequent KYC review. High-risk customers are subject to annual KYC periodic reviews rather than the standard 3–5 year cycle.
context: annually for high-risk customers

raw_entities.name: Lower-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: A customer classification indicating lower compliance risk requiring standard due diligence procedures. Lower-risk customers are subject to KYC periodic reviews on a 3–5 year cycle.
context: Every 3–5 years for lower-risk customers

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: A senior compliance role responsible for approving and handling exceptions to standard KYC procedures. The Compliance Head has authority to escalate and approve non-standard verification scenarios.
context: Escalation to Compliance Head for non-standard scenarios
